products.title: Bijur Delimon SureFire II Single-Phase Lubrication Pumps (SLR and PDI)
products.descriptionShort: Bijur Delimon SureFire II Single-Phase Lubrication Pumps (SLR and PDI): 26 part numbers, for SLR, PDI, Progressive systems; oil; 2 to 12 L reservoirs. SureFire II is Bijur Delimon's self-contained, electric motor-driven gear pump for automatic oil and fluid-grease lubrication of production machinery. From Indus Hydraulics, authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East, supplied direct from the manufacturer.
products.descriptionLong:
SureFire II is Bijur Delimon's self-contained, electric motor-driven gear pump for automatic oil and fluid-grease lubrication of production machinery. One pump serves up to about 100 lubrication points.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine units direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's datasheets and manuals.

How it works

Two versions share the pump: the SLR version feeds oil to single-line resistance (meter-unit) networks through a 75 psi relief valve, and the PDI version feeds oil or fluid grease to positive-displacement injectors through a 450 psi relief valve, venting the main line between cycles so the injectors reset. Reservoirs run from 2 to 30 litres in plastic or painted steel, with options for level and pressure monitoring, quick-coupling fill, a timer or a full controller, and DIN or M12 connectors.

Range

26 listed part numbers plus versions configured to order from 71,040 order codes (SFX…) — systems SLR, PDI, Progressive; lubricants Oil; reservoirs 2 to 12 L; supply 115VAC, 24VDC, 230VAC, 115/230VAC, 100/115VAC; output 250cc/min, 500cc/min, 125cc/min, 10-18cc/min, 250 cc/min; maximum pressure 75 psi (5 bar) to 450 psi (31 bar). The size table gives each part number's data.

Row descriptions are Bijur Delimon's own: LS / LLS level or low-level switch, HLS high-level switch, PG pressure gauge, PS pressure switch, CNTL controller, P&M pump and motor, SLR single-line resistance, PDI positive-displacement injector, PROG progressive. The columns give each part number's published data.

Where it is used

  • machine tools and transfer lines
  • packaging, printing and textile machinery
  • conveyors and assembly equipment
  • retrofit of older Bijur and third-party one-shot systems

Choosing the pump

Start from the distribution system the pump has to drive — SLR meter units, PDI injectors, progressive dividers, Dualine valves or direct multi-line feeds — then the lubricant: oil grade in cSt, or grease NLGI class (fluid grease for PDI). Size the reservoir for the refill interval you want, match the supply voltage and enclosure to the machine, and decide how the cycle is controlled: an integral timer or controller, an external controller, or the machine PLC. Level and pressure switches let the control system prove each cycle.

Complete systems

A pump is one part of a lubrication system. With it we supply the Bijur Delimon distribution — meter units, injectors, divider valves or Dualine valves — and the tubing, fittings, controllers and monitoring to match, sized to the number of points and the lubricant. Send us the machine and the lubrication points and we propose the full system.

faqs.question: What do you need for a quotation?
faqs.answer: The Bijur Delimon part number or order code if you have it; otherwise the machine, the number of lubrication points, the lubricant (oil grade or grease NLGI class), the supply voltage or air pressure, the reservoir size and any approval needed (CE, CSA, UL, ATEX). We confirm the part number with the manufacturer and quote with the delivery time.

faqs.question: How do I read the order code?
faqs.answer: The code is the series prefix followed by one code from each position in the order-code table on this page, in order. Send us the code or simply the options you need and we confirm it is a valid combination before quoting.

faqs.question: What is an SLR system?
faqs.answer: Single-line resistance: the pump pushes oil into one line and meter units — calibrated restrictors at each point — share it out by their flow rating. Simple and low-pressure, for oil on machine tools and light machinery.

faqs.question: What is a PDI system?
faqs.answer: Positive-displacement injector: every injector holds a measured shot and fires it when the pump pressurises the line; the pump then vents the line so the injectors refill. Each point gets a fixed volume regardless of back-pressure, with oil or fluid grease.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for high ambient temperatures in the Gulf?
faqs.answer: Bijur Delimon publishes an operating range of 5°C-40°C for this range. For installations above that — outdoor plant in summer, enclosures near furnaces — tell us the ambient and the lubricant and we confirm the configuration with the manufacturer.

Indus Hydraulics is an authorised Bijur Delimon distributor for the Middle East and supplies genuine units direct from the manufacturer, with the maker's datasheets and manuals.

How it works

A double-acting design gives even flow with low noise and low air use; mufflers are built in and the air motor has only three moving parts. Stub and drum versions, kits with hose, and a stainless 1:1 stub pump are listed.

Range

Where it is used

  • workshop and fleet oil bars
  • oil transfer from drums and totes

Choosing the pump

Pick the pressure ratio for the lubricant and the line: oil in volume through short runs needs a low ratio, grease through long lines, reels and central systems a high one. Then match the container — pail, 120 lb or 400 lb drum, 55-gallon drum or bulk tote — and the execution (stub, drum or flange mount, with or without follower plate and cover). Check the air supply the plant can give the pump at the flow it needs.
